description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of pass@1 accuracy percentages across different models, with the x-axis representing the pass@1 score ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, and the y-axis showing the percentage of models falling within each score range. The bars are color-coded: a light blue bar at 0.0–0.2 shows 11.2%, two light blue bars at 0.2–0.4 and 0.4–0.6 each show 3.4%, a light blue bar at 0.6–0.8 shows 5.8%, and a significantly taller light blue bar at 0.8–1.0 shows 76.2%. A red dashed vertical line is positioned at 0.8 on the x-axis, indicating the mean pass@1 value of 0.82, which is labeled in red text near the top of the chart. The chart highlights that the majority of models achieve a pass@1 score in the highest bin (0.8–1.0), with a mean performance of 0.82.
